excluded.reason: Answer quotes the words of consecration verbatim; the output refuser rejects that shape by design.
Question and answer quote the words of consecration verbatim; same design conflict as Q.241.

corpus_exclusion_rule.rule: A corpus passage is excluded when its question or answer quotes a guarded formula verbatim, because the output refuser rejects that shape by design regardless of intent. The exclusion is recorded in the corpus itself, not silently dropped.

description: Machine-readable guardrail policy extracted from the running Lumen refuser and request screen. Published in-repo only; not published to npm or any external registry.

enforcement_layers.description: Prompts that ask the system to perform a sacrament or imitate a named figure are refused with a graceful redirect before any retrieval happens.
Every candidate answer passes through the refuser before it is returned. A match hard-rejects the answer before it renders.

eval_cases.provenance: Referenced, not duplicated. This package does not copy the eval cases; adopters and checks use the file at that path in this repo.

name: lumen-guardrail-policy

publication.note: No npm publication or other external registry publication is claimed.

request_screen.note: These are the rules in the catechism demo, in source order. The Proverbs and Tao Te Ching exhibits carry the same core rules and add exhibit-specific named_imitation rules for Solomon and Laozi respectively; those additions live in their own guarded_qa.mjs files and are not part of this core list.

sync_check.description: Mechanically verifies every reason code, output pattern, request screen pattern, and corpus exclusion in this file appears verbatim in the source files named above. Exits non-zero and names each mismatch if any does not.

tradeoff: Verbatim quotation of guarded formulas in teaching text is blocked. The refuser rejects the shape regardless of intent, so teaching texts that quote the guarded formulas are refused (recorded as borderline, not scored, in the eval), and corpus questions 241 and 242 are excluded for the same reason.
